The people harmed by this xenophobic and racist policy weren’t those trying to cheat the system. They were the people who followed every rule, submitted every document, and paid every fee they were required to.

tweets.text:
Fact check: False ⭐

If anyone still believes @ICEgov after they’ve been found to lie to courts of law numerous times, they should have their heads checked. 

Immigration detainees with no criminal records are being held under the same, and in some cases worse, restrictive conditions as criminal defendants. 

At MDC Brooklyn:
- Detainees are forced to remain in their cells for as long as 22 hours a day
- Water provided is brown and filled with sediment 
- Requests for medical care are repeatedly denied, including for kidney pain and dental infections
- There are strict restrictions on phone calls that limit access to legal representation 

@ICEgov - I've seen it in person. You're lying.

author.description: Congressman for New York's 10th District in the House of Representatives

tweets.text:
For over 70 years, adjusting your status to a Green Card from within the US has been the standard pathway to achieve permanent legal status. 

Now Trump wants to change that solely to inflict damage on our immigrants and mixed families by forcing people to wait often years in their home country.

This is a stupid as it is cruel. And it solely targets legal immigrants. 

We won’t let this happen.

author.description: Congressman for New York's 10th District in the House of Representatives

tweets.text:
.@GovKathyHochul was entirely right to end the 287(g) agreements because our local criminal law enforcement does not exist to serve as an extension of ICE’s lawless civil immigration dragnet.

Let’s be clear: New York turns over to ICE immigrants who have completed their criminal sentences. But ICE wants New York to use our limited criminal law enforcement officers to help them round up immigrants who have committed no crimes. 

If @RealTomHoman follows through with this desperate federal overreach, my office and our coalition will be on the ground every day to fight back.

New Yorkers will not be intimidated.
